fireplace.label: Fireplace
fireplace.note: the Fireplace (Michael, 2026-10-26, the fire rulings under Round rooms: a spec; it replaced the generated hearth): the drawn fireplace, two tiles along a flat wall indoors, its facing from the wall it backs onto (src/setdown.js fitFor); a switch (docs/43 section 3), out when built; cooks; never moved; taken apart out for half its stone; no tool (the builder's default, as the hearth's was)

fire_pit.label: Fire pit
fire_pit.note: the fire pit (Michael, 2026-10-26, the fire rulings): 2 by 2 on open ground, indoors or out, never on water (roads are fine), clear of a door's two tiles; a switch, out when built; cooks; never moved; taken apart out for half its stone; the cost and the seconds Primary's and the builder's defaults; no tool, as the Fireplace

feed_trough.label: Feeding trough
feed_trough.note: docs/45 section 3: a feeding trough (not the water trough) in a pen, filled with grain, vegetables, or hay; built from the palette, planks (Primary's default)

round_stone.label: Round stone wall
round_stone.note: docs/50: a round room, 5 or 7 across, by a drag from one corner of its square; stone only, shown and buildable only while Free building is on (Michael, 2026-10-27: "A few on the map, buildable by dev settings, otherwise not in the game yet until we settle on cost, etc."); its cost is per edge of the outline (40 stone at 5, 56 at 7), a placeholder and Primary's default, never charged since Free building waives it; the seconds the builder's default (two fifths more at 7)

floor_wood.label: Plank floor
floor_wood.note: docs/49 section 5 (Michael, 2026-10-27, 02 "Floors are built a tile at a time, with no physics"): a tile at a time, by a drag for a rectangle; on the ground over the floor there (kept, and put back when it is taken up), on a storey wherever it touches a floor already walkable there; shown and buildable only while Free building is on until the floors are costed (Primary's default, as the round stone wall); 1 plank a tile, a placeholder and Primary's default, never charged while Free building is on; the seconds a tile the builder's default

floor_stone.label: Stone floor
floor_stone.note: as the Plank floor, in the stone floor the map already draws; 1 stone a tile (Primary's default)

stair_wood.label: Wood stair
stair_wood.note: docs/49 section 5: a stair three tiles long from the tile under the cursor, climbing on away from the player, its landing's planks laid on the storey above (one of its planks); north and west only for now (Primary's default: "Stairs climb away from the camera", Michael to confirm); the drawn stair (art round 8); never taken apart (ruled); Free building only for now; the cost docs/49 section 5's default, never charged while Free building is on; the seconds the builder's default

stair_stone.label: Stone stair
stair_stone.note: as the Wood stair, in stone (9 stone and a plank, docs/49 section 5's default); its landing a stone floor
